主要内容: Core Laboratories N.V. announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.55 per share for Q3 2019, payable on August 12, 2019, to shareholders of record on July 22, 2019. The dividend rate represents $2.20 per share annually if maintained. Dutch withholding tax of 15% will apply. Future dividends will depend on financial position, earnings, capital expenditure, share repurchases, and other factors. The company is a leading provider of proprietary and patented reservoir description and production enhancement services used to optimize petroleum reservoir performance.
